'''Nam Chorios''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Chorios system]]. Though desolate, it was able to support [[Human/Legends|Human]] life. It was even able to grow vegetation, such as [[brachniel]] and [[gomex moss]]. The planet was in a constant state of dusk due to its dim sun.

==History==
About [[752 BBY]], the planet was colonized by refugees from [[Meridian]]. The [[Grissmath Dynasty]] of Meridian founded a penal colony on the world around [[700 BBY]]. The Grissmaths introduced [[Droch/Legends|drochs]] to the planet in a failed attempt to kill the prisoners. Centuries later, a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Beldorion]] traveled to Nam Chorios and discovered that its [[Tsil]] crystals' energy magnified his [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]]. Beldorion would set himself up as a petty local tyrant.
[[File:Nam_Chorios.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Force storm (weather)|Force Storm]] on Nam Chorios.]]
Eventually, the descendants of the original prisoners had become a tough, independent group of settlers called the "[[Oldtimer]]s". A group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Oldtimers organized themselves into the [[Theran Listener]]s.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] was exiled to Nam Chorios by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for opposing increased security measures, a move which upset [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. The Oldtimers came into conflict with a more recent group of settlers called the "Newcomers" in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. Seti Ashgad planned to unleash a deadly infestation of drochs throughout the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] called the [[Death Seed]] as part of a deal with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles|Getelles]] of the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]] and the [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]], in which Getelles's [[Navy/Legends|navy]] would then invade the Meridian Sector. However, their plot failed because of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] efforts and the [[Battle of Nam Chorios|intervention]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]].<ref name="POT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>

The planet was invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] as they swept through the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] on their way toward [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[44 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] [[Operation Shieldfall|confronted]] the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], as well as a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|group]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], on the planet.<ref name="FOTJ Convinction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>
